name: Deposit by Ouroboros Apps
description: Deposit by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). Freelance deposit and payment schedule: approved deposits, payment dates, and client wording; deposit waivers and date changes need approval. Tools: list_schedules, start_schedule, read_schedule, record_deposit, add_later_payment, move_payment_date, waive_deposit, mark_deposit_paid, write_client_script, commit_schedule, suggest_schedule_change, accept_schedule_change. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/deposit. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/deposit.
author: Ouroboros Apps
